create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object to build a finite state transducer for pattern recognition
add_node_to_graph: add a start or final node to a gtn Graph with optional is_start and is_final flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a symbol label
draw_gtn_graph: draw a gtn Graph to a PDF file with input and output symbol mappings
union_gtn_graphs: union multiple gtn Graph objects into a single combined graph
